''See also: [[hunger binding Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Hunger [[binding|bindings]] are specialized spiritual [[constructs]] composed of [[hunger madra]]. They function by devouring, absorbing, or merging with external energy and matter, acting much like a void or an insatiable stomach. When activated, these [[binding|bindings]] can pull [[madra]] from other [[sacred artists]], destabilize enemy techniques, or consume physical and spiritual strength. They can be integrated into various vessels, such as limbs, weapons, or animals, and are used to facilitate the absorption of essence. In practice, these [[binding|bindings]] can be utilized to repair damaged limbs by extracting similar [[binding|bindings]] from creatures or to strengthen weapons by channeling [[madra]] through them. However, they carry significant risks; improper use or incompatibility with different types of matter can lead to instability or the [[destruction]] of the [[construct]]. The nature of [[hunger madra]] is described as a singular, interconnected force characterized by an endless greed for more. Historically, these [[binding|bindings]] have been fused into animals or used in large-[[scale]] traps to concentrate [[hunger aura]]. The integration of such [[binding|bindings]] into [[blood madra]] eventually led to the creation of the [[Path of the Hungry Deep]], a powerful method focused on consuming the strength and [[Authority|authority]] of [[dragons]].}}
